title: Travel-series poem-specific scholarly phrase topology
purpose: Upgrade the v1.17 travel-series phrase network from repository-normalized recurrence to poem-specific scholarly-transcription recurrence visible in Yamauchi 1974, without claiming original Edo glyph verification or whole-candidate naturalness.

source.author: 山内潤三
source.article: 廻文歌の限界と効用 (下)――高野山釈教長歌を頂点として――

verified_series_repetitions.same_author_parallel: 高野山釈教長歌: 参るなかたひ -> 参る長旅

verified_series_repetitions.source_layer_claim: Yamauchi scholarly transcription explicitly prints 日

new_evidence: The complete ku1 やとちかく recurs inside poem 91 ku5.
The ku5 suffix くかちとや is independently a complete ku1 in poem 91.
Thus both major lexical spans of the donor outer frame participate in the same travel-series phrase network independently of the generated candidate.
why_not_deep_review_supported: The generated poem's whole sentence-level syntax remains unannotated.
The first and fifth ku being source-attested and series-recurrent does not prove how they syntactically connect to the host middle.
No original Edo source image has been inspected.

travel_90_ku5_assessment.series_support: はまも recurs in poem 91 as はまも日たかし
travel_90_ku5_assessment.dictionary_hypothesis: はまも + くが + も + と

series_model.finding: Travel poems 90, 91, 93 and 94 reuse mirrored phrase fragments across different metrical positions, consistent with an authorial phrase-bank or phrase-topology strategy for palindrome composition.
not_claimed: that every repeated phrase has identical kanji in the original source
that every repeated phrase has identical morphology in every occurrence
that any newly recombined full poem is natural classical Japanese

safety_rule.rule: Repeated spans visible in poem-specific scholarly transcriptions may strengthen local boundary and source-attestation evidence, but they do not by themselves certify cross-boundary syntax in a generated hybrid.

next_action: Freeze the travel family at promising-but-parse-needed unless poem-specific lexical/syntactic annotation or original source images resolve the remaining cross-ku syntax; shift active effort to verified corpus expansion.
